title: TSMC Confirms Employee Data Breach Linked to Cloud Partner
excerpt: TSMC acknowledges a data breach after a threat actor attempts to auction 6.9GB of stolen employee information online.
body_html:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) has confirmed that personal employee information has been leaked online. The confirmation follows an incident where a threat actor listed 6.9 gigabytes of data, allegedly stolen from the company, up for auction.

According to TSMC, the leaked information was traced back to a breach involving one of the company's cloud service providers rather than a direct intrusion into TSMC's own internal networks. The semiconductor manufacturer stated that the exposed details relate to employee data.

Investigations into the incident are ongoing to determine the full scope of the exposure and the exact mechanism of the third-party compromise.
